notes: in_the_box is empty: none of the searched documents gives an official in-the-box list for this filament.

TDS facts with no registry key (not written): Spool Material PC + ABS (90 °C); Spool Size 200 mm × 67 mm; Printing and Storage Humidity < 20% RH; Bed Surface Preparation Glue; Retraction Length 0.6 - 1.0 mm; Retraction Speed 20 - 40 mm/s; Chamber Temperature 25 - 45 °C (thermal.chamber_temp is a number key, this is a recommended range); Max Overhang Angle ~ 55°; Max Bridging Length 30 mm; Support for PLA; Melt Index 23.3 ± 2.4 g/10 min (210 °C, 2.16 kg); Crystallization Temperature "/"; Saturated Water Absorption Rate 0.46% (25 °C, 55% RH); Young's Modulus 2030 ± 210 MPa (X-Y) / 1750 ± 180 MPa (Z); every Z-direction mechanical value; annealing 50 to 60 °C for 6 to 12 hours.
SDS: Model "A12-xx (xx stands for any suffix)"; not written as identity.model, which the identity map sets to "PLA Glow".

The store page lists a "Filament RoHS" document (https://store.bblcdn.com/2c7b9c30a9014c65bb4aeacd9c70e6af.pdf) that is not cached; safety.certifications is therefore neither written nor listed as not_published.
